headline: Ethereum Core Developers Patch Staking Flaw Ahead of Glamsterdam Upgrade
summary: Ethereum developers reversed course and resolved a software bug in the upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade that could have misdirected staking deposits to block builders instead of validators.
why: Ethereum is the primary smart contract platform securing hundreds of billions in digital assets; fixing protocol flaws is essential to maintaining network consensus integrity.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: Repairing the staking deposit flaw removes a major technical risk prior to the upgrade launch.
